name: Create a repository variable
description: Create a repository variable Creates a repository variable that you can reference in a GitHub Actions workflow. POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/variables
context:
POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/variables
Creates a repository variable that you can reference in a GitHub Actions workflow. Authenticated users must have collaborator access to a repository to create, update, or read variables. OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.; body (body)

name: Delete a repository variable
description: Delete a repository variable Deletes a repository variable using the variable name. DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/variables/{name}

name: Get a repository variable
description: Get a repository variable Gets a specific variable in a repository. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/variables/{name}

name: List repository variables
description: List repository variables Lists all repository variables. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/variables
context:
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/variables
Lists all repository variables. Authenticated users must have collaborator access to a repository to create, update, or read variables. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
Optional: per_page (query) — The number of results per page (max 30). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."; page (query) — The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."

name: Update a repository variable
description: Update a repository variable Updates a repository variable that you can reference in a GitHub Actions workflow. PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/variables/{name}
